license_required.quote: If any person who does not possess a valid license to practice medicine within this state and who is not exempted from the licensing requirements does any of the acts constituting the practice of medicine, he or she shall be deemed to be practicing medicine without complying with the provisions of the Arkansas Medical Practices Act

issuing_authority.quote: Every person desiring a license to practice medicine shall make application to the Arkansas State Medical Board.

name.quote: Every person desiring a license to practice medicine shall make application to the Arkansas State Medical Board.

type.quote: The Arkansas State Medical Board shall:

age_minimum.quote: Is at least twenty-one (21) years of age

moral_character_required.quote: Has not been guilty of acts constituting unprofessional conduct as defined in § 17-95-409

degree_required.value: Graduate of a recognized United States or Canadian medical school, or a foreign medical school approved by the Arkansas State Medical Board
degree_required.quote: Is a graduate of: A recognized United States or Canadian medical school whose entrance requirements and course of instruction have been approved by the Council on Medical Education of the American Medical Association

accrediting_body.value: Council on Medical Education of the American Medical Association
accrediting_body.quote: A recognized United States or Canadian medical school whose entrance requirements and course of instruction have been approved by the Council on Medical Education of the American Medical Association

required.quote: Served three (3) years as an intern, resident, or fellow, or a combination thereof, in an accredited postgraduate medical education program in the United States

duration.value: 3 years (for foreign medical graduates); 1 year internship may be required by the board
duration.quote: Served three (3) years as an intern, resident, or fellow, or a combination thereof, in an accredited postgraduate medical education program in the United States

kind.value: internship, residency, or fellowship in accredited postgraduate medical education program
kind.quote: served one (1) year of internship in a general accredited hospital

exams.name: Board-approved examination (e.g., USMLE)
exams.notes: The board approves and designates the examinations by rule
exams.quote: Has successfully passed an examination approved by the Arkansas State Medical Board as set forth in its rules.

interval_years.quote: The annual license or reregistration fee of a physician licensed by the Arkansas State Medical Board to practice medicine in the State of Arkansas shall be paid before or during the birth month of the license holder beginning in 1998, and each year thereafter.

required.quote: The regulatory boards of the professions or occupations classified by the laws of the State of Arkansas as professions of the healing arts ... are authorized to adopt rules requiring the continuing education of the persons licensed by the board.

available.quote: A legally licensed physician and surgeon who has been issued a license to practice medicine in another state where the requirements for licensure are equal to those established by the State of Arkansas may be permitted by the Arkansas State Medical Board to practice his or her profession in this state without taking an examination

requirements.value: Requirements for licensure in the other state must be equal to those of Arkansas; issuance is at the sole discretion of the board
requirements.quote: The issuance of a license by credentials by the board shall be at the sole discretion of the board, and the board may provide such rules governing such an admission as may be deemed necessary by or desirable to the board.

regulatory_model.quote: Every person who practices or attempts to practice medicine in any of its branches ... within this state without first having complied with the provisions of the Arkansas Medical Practices Act ... shall be deemed guilty of a misdemeanor.

credential_type.quote: Every person desiring a license to practice medicine shall make application to the Arkansas State Medical Board.

is_mandatory.quote: If any person who does not possess a valid license to practice medicine within this state and who is not exempted from the licensing requirements does any of the acts constituting the practice of medicine, he or she shall be deemed to be practicing medicine without complying with the provisions of the Arkansas Medical Practices Act

title_protection.quote: Using the title "M.D.", "M.B.", "D.O.", "physician", "surgeon", or any other word or abbreviation to indicate or induce others to believe that one is engaged in the diagnosis or treatment of persons afflicted with disease, injury, or defect of body or mind

scope_protection.quote: any person who practices or attempts to practice medicine in the State of Arkansas without first obtaining a license authorizing him or her to so practice medicine is a public nuisance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony listed under § 17-3-102
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony listed under § 17-3-102. The judgment of any such conviction, unless pending upon appeal, shall be conclusive evidence of unprofessional conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Resorting to fraud, misrepresentation, or deception in applying for or securing a license or renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Resorting to fraud, misrepresentation, or deception in applying for or securing a license to practice medicine, in taking the examination for the license, or in seeking a renewal of a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to practice medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to practice medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring or aiding in procuring a wrongful and criminal abortion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring or aiding or abetting in procuring a wrongful and criminal abortion

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of laws regulating possession, distribution, or use of narcotic or controlled drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the laws of the United States or the State of Arkansas regulating the possession, distribution, or use of narcotic or controlled drugs classed in Schedules I-V

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual indulgence in alcohol to the extent of incapacity to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual indulgence in the use of alcohol to such an extent as to render himself or herself incapable of exercising that degree of skill and judgment in the treatment of his or her patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual, intemperate, or excessive use of narcotics or habit-forming drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual, intemperate, or excessive use of narcotics or of any other habit-forming drugs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing to a patient that a manifestly incurable condition can be permanently cured
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing to a patient that a manifestly incurable condition of sickness, disease, or injury can be permanently cured

disciplinary_grounds.description: Becoming physically or mentally incompetent to practice medicine to such an extent as to endanger the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Becoming physically or mentally incompetent to practice medicine to such an extent as to endanger the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Insanity or mental disease evidenced by adjudication or voluntary commitment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Insanity or mental disease, if evidenced by an adjudication or by voluntary commitment to an institution for treatment of a mental disease

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting for patronage or advertising in a false, fraudulent, deceptive, or misleading manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Soliciting for patronage; advertising for patronage in a false, fraudulent, deceptive, or misleading manner; advertising the quality of medical services; or advertising illegal procedures and practices

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering to cure disease by a secret method or refusing to divulge treatment methods to the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering, undertaking, attempting, or agreeing to cure or treat disease by a secret method, procedure, treatment, or medicine or representing, directly or indirectly, that he or she can treat, operate on, or prescribe for any human condition by a method, means, or procedure which he or she refuses to divulge upon demand to the Arkansas State Medical Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: The willful betraying of a professional secret
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The willful betraying of a professional secret

disciplinary_grounds.description: Persistent and flagrant overcharging or overtreating of patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Persistent and flagrant overcharging or overtreating of patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a rule of the Arkansas State Medical Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a rule of the Arkansas State Medical Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a term of probation or an order previously imposed by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a term of probation or an order previously imposed by the Arkansas State Medical Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having been found in violation of a statute or rule governing medicine by a licensing authority of another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having been found in violation of a statute or a rule governing the practice of medicine by a medical licensing authority or agency of another state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing an ethical violation as determined by the board by rule
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing an ethical violation as determined by the Arkansas State Medical Board by rule

definition_quote.value: "Practice of medicine" means: Holding out oneself to the public within this state as being able to diagnose, treat, prescribe for, palliate, or prevent any human disease, ailment, injury, deformity, or physical or mental condition, whether by the use of drugs, surgery, manipulation, electricity, or any physical, mechanical, or other means whatsoever
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of medicine" means: Holding out oneself to the public within this state as being able to diagnose, treat, prescribe for, palliate, or prevent any human disease, ailment, injury, deformity, or physical or mental condition, whether by the use of drugs, surgery, manipulation, electricity, or any physical, mechanical, or other means whatsoever

methods_authorized.quote: whether by the use of drugs, surgery, manipulation, electricity, or any physical, mechanical, or other means whatsoever

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe, administer, and dispense drugs including controlled substances; dispensing of legend drugs requires prior board approval
drug_authority.quote: A physician licensed under the Arkansas Medical Practices Act ... shall not dispense legend drugs without prior approval by the Arkansas State Medical Board after application to the Arkansas State Medical Board and on the showing of need.

license_status_types.quote: The Arkansas State Medical Board may issue an academic license to practice medicine to any physician

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must have their school approved by the Arkansas State Medical Board and must have served 3 years as intern/resident/fellow in accredited US postgraduate program, or 3 years outside US plus all USMLE steps plus ECFMG certification plus fellowship or ABMS certification, or 1 year US residency plus current enrollment in Arkansas accredited program
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: A foreign medical school whose entrance requirements and course of instruction have been approved by the Arkansas State Medical Board. He or she must also have: Served three (3) years as an intern, resident, or fellow, or a combination thereof, in an accredited postgraduate medical education program in the United States

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: A properly verified certificate that he or she has served one (1) year of internship in a general accredited hospital

pain_management_education_required.quote: At any level of sanction, the board may require continuing medical education hours in proper prescribing habits.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: The board shall promulgate rules limiting the amount of Schedule II narcotics that may be prescribed and dispensed by licensees of the board.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: Promulgate rules limiting the amount of Schedule II narcotics that may be prescribed and dispensed by licensees of the board.

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: Comply with the Prescription Drug Monitoring Program Act, § 20-7-601 et seq., concerning the reporting requirements to the Prescription Drug Monitoring Program.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Healthcare services provided by telemedicine, including a prescription through telemedicine, shall be held to the same standard of care as healthcare services provided in person; a professional relationship must be established before telemedicine services are provided
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: Healthcare services provided by telemedicine, including without limitation a prescription through telemedicine, shall be held to the same standard of care as healthcare services provided in person.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: Any physician who seeks licensure in this state pursuant to the requirements of § 17-95-206, upon submission of the proper credentialing documents to the Arkansas State Medical Board, shall be issued a temporary license to practice medicine in this state until such time as final action is taken by the board on the physician's application.

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: review applications for licensure or renewal and for approval of the protocol between the physician assistant and the supervising physician

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may be granted prescriptive authority by the supervising physician; the Physician Assistant Committee recommends approval, disapproval, or modification of applications for prescriptive privileges
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: Recommend the approval, disapproval, or modification of the application for prescriptive privileges for a physician assistant.

max_physician_assistants_per_supervising.quote: Limit supervision to no more than two (2) graduate registered physicians per supervising physician.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The Arkansas Medical Society, Inc. shall have the authority to establish a physicians' health committee ... to undertake the functions and responsibilities to carry out the purposes of this subchapter

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: If the Arkansas State Medical Board has reason to believe that a physician is impaired ... either board may cause an evaluation of the physician or dentist to be conducted by the appropriate committee for the purpose of determining if there is an impairment.

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: The Arkansas State Medical Board may issue an academic license to practice medicine to any physician who meets: The qualifications and requirements set forth in the rules of the Arkansas State Medical Board

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: In cases of emergency and to prevent hardship, the Director of the Arkansas State Medical Board may issue a temporary permit to practice medicine

investigational_drug_protection.quote: A physician shall not be subject to disciplinary action by the Arkansas State Medical Board solely for prescribing dangerous or controlled drugs for the relief of chronic intractable pain.
